desc:
Take the Korean L! Welcome to the battle! Someone is holding an L, and it will explode soon. Don't be the last person holding an L!

Enter the playground and survive until the end!
What if you receive an L? Pass it on by touching someone else - "Pass the L!"
The bomb timer is secret! The countdown only shows in the last 5 seconds!
If you're holding an L, you'll go faster - chase it and pass it before it explodes!
If you press the L button while holding L, you will fail immediately due to an explosion at that location!
The more people there are, the more Ls there will be!
If you survive until the end, you will receive coins and victory!
L Skin Collection: Gold, Red, Mint, Tree, Neon, Diamond, Space!
Climb up the leaderboard and prove that you won't get an absolute L.

Can we avoid the L? Come in now and check it out!
